subject: Vendor onboarding: DPA e-sign, SOC 2 link, and subprocessor list for Zephyr Labs
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@zephyrlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: onboarding docs and PO instructions from Zephyr Labs

Hi Karthik and Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Procurement at Zephyr Labs needs the following to move our vendor activation forward:

- Executable DPA for signature (please send via DocuSign)
- Latest SOC 2 report or link to download
- Current subprocessor roster with hosting/provider details and data residency flags
- Vendor setup instructions for our PO team and required legal name and tax info

Could you confirm how you prefer to receive our PO and whether Redwood can accept net-30? We aim to get this live by end of month.

Attachments we will provide on our side once DPA is in place.

Appreciate a short checklist if possible.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Zephyr Labs
elena@zephyrlabs.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@zephyrlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: onboarding docs and PO instructions from Zephyr Labs

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the note. I attached our standard DPA for signature and a current subprocessor list. Our SOC 2 report is available at the link below. Quick answers up front: we can accept net-30 for standard enterprise customers; if you need an expedited activation we can request an exception from finance.

What I attached:
- Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (attachment stub)
- subprocessor_list_2026.csv (attachment stub)

Links:
- SOC 2 report: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/SOC2_Q4_2025.pdf
- DocuSign envelope for the DPA: https://docusign.com/ZX9a1-DocuSign-Envelope
- Vendor setup form for PO routing: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-external/vendor-activation (see form in the folder)

Please return the signed DPA via the DocuSign flow. For PO setup we need: legal company name, billing contact name/email, remit address, and PO number to attach to the invoice. If billing is outside the US and you require specific tax forms let me know.

If your team needs the subprocessor mapping by region I can pull additional detail for the hosting providers.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: subprocessor_list_2026.csv (csv)]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@zephyrlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin O'Neill <kevin.oneill@zephyrlabs.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: onboarding docs and PO instructions from Zephyr Labs

Karthik,

We sent the DPA through DocuSign and Kevin completed the signature this morning. I attached the signed copy for your records and also added a note on data residency: our security team is primarily concerned about whether customer data is hosted in EU regions for our EU customers. Could you confirm which subprocessors handle EU-hosted workloads and whether any encrypted key escrow is required?

Signed DPA attached: signed_DPA_Zephyr_2026-07-16.pdf (attachment stub)

For PO routing, our billing contact is:
Janelle Park
Billing Operations
billing@zephyrlabs.com
PO number will be ZPH-PO-7782 and we prefer net-30.

Let me know if you need anything else to get the PO and activation moving.

Best,
Elena

Marissa / Rishi,

Forwarding completed DPA and Zephyr's billing details. They signed via DocuSign and will submit PO ZPH-PO-7782 with net-30. Request: can we prioritize vendor activation for Zephyr and route the invoice to accounts payable this week so their engineering team can start smoke testing? They are asking for EU subprocessor detail as part of their security checklist. I attached our subprocessor list but flagged which providers have EU regions; legal may want to confirm the mapping.

Attachments: signed_DPA_Zephyr_2026-07-16.pdf, subprocessor_list_2026.csv

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa: approve expedited activation or advise on finance exception process
- Rishi: confirm whether subprocessor list visibility is sufficient or if a redacted mapping is required for EU residency answers

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-17T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: onboarding docs and PO instructions from Zephyr Labs

Thanks Karthik. Approved to expedite activation for Zephyr Labs. Finance will accept PO ZPH-PO-7782 on net-30. Please route the invoice to billing@zephyrlabs.com once the activation is complete. I added a short vendor activation checklist to the thread for the ops team.

Checklist highlights:
- Confirm signed DPA in vendor file (done)
- Confirm SOC 2 link is current and store copy in secure drive (Karthik)
- Confirm subprocessor EU mapping with Rishi and redacted copy to Zephyr if requested
- Create vendor record in accounting and attach PO number
- Activate trial capacity and run smoke tests, then confirm go-live date

Rishi: please review the attached subprocessor list and mark any items that need redaction before we share with Zephyr. If everything looks fine, provide the redacted CSV and I will send it to Elena.

I will open the PO routing ticket and add the HubSpot deal id: https://hubspot.com/deals/ZPH-2026-001.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: Vendor_Activation_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]
